title: The Energy Between the Songs
summary: Documenting the scale of the room and the small, human moments happening inside it.
body:
Use this page for a full visual case study. Start with the atmosphere you wanted to preserve and the access you had to the room.

## Looking for the moment

A strong project story is not only a gallery. Explain how you see: the gestures, light, movement, and tension you wait for.

## Made to travel

Describe where the final work lived—campaigns, social posts, artist archives, publications, or simply in the memories of the people who were there.
